verdict.rationale: The evidence only glances at business verification. Accounts can represent a business ([persona-docs-40]) and Connect shares KYB data between organizations ([persona-docs-44]), which implies KYB data exists in the product, and workflows can run additional reports on conditions ([persona-docs-23]). Nothing in the pack describes how business verification is actually done. Missing for 10: business registry lookups, UBO identification, a documented KYB flow, and evidence of KYB chaining into KYC on the beneficial owners.
